accent-cobalt.purpose: Accent on graphite: focus rings, caret, selected thumbnail ring, active-job text. Hue and chroma follow the chosen palette.

chrome-highlight.purpose: Top stop of the liquid chrome gradient.

chrome-body.purpose: Mid stops of the liquid chrome gradient; the representative chrome tone.

chrome-horizon.purpose: The darkest stop at the 50 % mirror horizon.

themes.note: Neutrals are defined per theme in src/styles/tokens.css under :root/[data-theme=dark] (graphite) and [data-theme=light] (steel). Accent hue/chroma come from [data-palette]: cobalt 250/0.13, iris 292/0.13, jade 166/0.10, ember 45/0.14, graphite 250/0.012.

wordmark.purpose: "Print Studio" beside the chrome drop mark.

control.purpose: Field values, segment labels, row labels, button text (Print at 620).

label.purpose: Meta lines, history group labels, menu labels, tooltips.

shadows.name: field
shadows.purpose: Raised value keys, toggled icon keys, glyph tiles, disabled Print.

shadows.name: well
shadows.purpose: Segmented controls, steppers, inputs, search, theme switcher, sending Print.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, tooltips, notices, job and document chips, stage bar.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The preview sheet only; the one deep shadow.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Narrow-screen drawer and the Print sending fill.

motion.name: t-press
motion.purpose: Press scale (.94 to .98) on every pressable.

motion.name: t-mid
motion.purpose: Segment thumb slide, chevron rotation, Print label swap.

motion.name: tooltip-in
motion.purpose: Tooltip open; subsequent tooltips open instantly (data-state=instant-open).

motion.name: menu-in
motion.value: 170ms scale(.96) translateY(-2px) + fade, from the trigger's transform origin

motion.name: print-sheen
motion.purpose: Slow sheen across the Print slab; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: print-fill
motion.purpose: Chrome fills the emptied Print well while sending.

motion.name: theme-switch
motion.purpose: Cross-fade of colours and shadows when the theme changes.

motion.name: keyboard
motion.purpose: Menus, tooltips and the segment thumb change instantly when the last input was a key press.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Menus and tooltips fade; press scale, sheen, pulse and shimmer stop; MotionConfig reducedMotion=user.

breakpoints.name: narrow

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Print becomes a square; zoom leaves the stage bar.

narrative.northStar: The Chrome Key on a Graphite Desk
narrative.overview:
Print Studio is a dark graphite instrument with one lit object in it: the sheet of paper about to be printed. The ground is flat and quiet, the controls are low dark keys and sunken wells that carry values, and a single material, polished liquid chrome with a highlight that follows the pointer, marks the few things that commit or select. Light mode keeps the same structure on a cool neutral steel grey; it is never cream.

Density is high but calm. Every print preference lives in one 60 px toolbar row of icon keys, wells and value fields; the sidebar is a history list; the rest of the screen is a lit stage where the page floats. Structure comes from tone steps and 1 px hairlines, not boxes. Words are few and sentence case, set in Funnel Sans, with Funnel Display reserved for titles and the wordmark.

Motion is quick and quiet: a strong ease-out, presses that give slightly under the finger, menus that grow from their trigger, and nothing that moves when the keyboard is driving.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground (dark) or cool steel grey (light), with a radial-lit stage behind the paper.
Liquid chrome is a signal, not a finish: Print, the selected segment, New print, the avatar bezel, the checked theme and the empty-state drop mark.
Two control families: raised dark keys that hold a value, and inset wells that hold a choice.
The paper sheet is the only object with deep, layered shadow.
Funnel Display for titles and the wordmark, Funnel Sans for everything else, tabular numerals throughout.
Ease-out `cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)`, 140 ms presses, 170 ms origin-aware menus, no motion under keyboard control.

rules.name: The Chrome Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Chrome marks what commits or what is chosen: Print (and the Sign in button, which is the Print slab), the selected segment thumb, New print, the avatar bezel, the checked theme item and the empty-state drop mark. Nothing else gets the chrome gradient; a new surface earns it only by being the single commit or current selection in its group.

rules.name: The Accent Is a Line Rule
rules.body: The accent appears as a 1.5 to 2 px ring, a caret, a check or a small glyph. It never fills a button or a panel.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status tone sits next to a word or a shape: a dot plus "Ready", a meta line reading "Failed · 23:38".

rules.name: The Display Is for Names Rule
rules.body: Funnel Display is used only for titles, names and the wordmark. Controls, labels and numbers are always Funnel Sans.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at their natural tracking. No uppercase tracking, no monospace, no italics.

rules.name: The Only Deep Shadow Is Paper Rule
rules.body: The sheet is the one object lifted high off the stage. Everything else stays within 1 to 2 px of the plane, or floats with the single Float shadow.

rules.name: The Keys Up, Choices Down Rule
rules.body: A control that holds a value (select trigger, text button) is raised; a control that holds a choice among options (segments, stepper, input) is an inset well, and the chosen option rises out of it in chrome.

rules.name: The No Pill Rule
rules.body: Buttons and controls are never capsules. A 38 px Print slab is 12 px round, not 19.

dos: Do give chrome only to the commit or the current selection in a group, and keep text on it in chrome ink.
Do put a new print preference in the toolbar as an icon key, value field or segmented well at 36 px, with a tooltip and an accessible name.
Do separate regions with 1 px inset hairlines (6 % white dark, 8 % ink light) and tone steps, not borders or cards.
Do use the accent only as a 1.5 to 2 px ring, a caret, a check or a small glyph.
Do pair every status colour with a word or a shape.
Do press with a .94 to .98 scale over 140 ms on `cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)`, and skip animation when `html[data-kbd]` is set.
Do define every new surface in both the graphite and the steel theme.
donts: Don't use cream or off-white for any background; the only near-white is paper.
Don't make buttons or controls pill-shaped.
Don't fill buttons or panels with the accent colour.
Don't give anything other than the paper sheet a deep, layered drop shadow.
Don't set controls, labels or numbers in Funnel Display, or use uppercase tracking, monospace or italics for labels.
Don't nest a boxed pane inside another pane in the workspace.
Don't animate movement under reduced motion; keep fades only.
